newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil supported by Asia and diesel demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil supported by Asia and diesel demand.

text.p: NWE gas oil was propelled higher on Friday by stronger IPE futures and firm premiums, backed in some cases by barrel tightness.
May IPE gas oil last traded at $163.25, up $2.75, but spent much of the day in a higher range near its high of $164.75.
Asia is estimated to have drawn between 1.5 and 1.8 million tonnes over the last six weeks or so, with between 500-800,000 tonnes sourced from NWE.
Russian cargo premiums held steady with bids heard around May IPE +$1 cif NWE. But there were no real offers in the market.

Diesel held on to the limelight with buyers looking for material into both France and Poland. Second half barrels were pegged around May IPE +$12 cif Le Havre and +$14 for Bordeaux. Some Russian 0.05 was understood offered at May IPE +$10.50 cif Hamburg.
FOD and DIN were quieter although May 1-10 DIN was offered at May IPE +$5 cif NWE.
